explication: HivisionIDPhoto turns an uploaded portrait into standardized ID photos, with optional background replacement, beauty adjustments, print layouts, watermarks, and template photos. The main UI flow is Gradio → processor → ID-photo creator → downloadable outputs; a CLI and API provide additional entry points. Face detection and matting are selectable, including an optional online Face++ detector. The creator’s orchestration and API implementation were not sampled, so those links reflect the documented product flow; unsampled subsystem details are kept at their supported paths.
